scientific_integrity: An analytic all-parameter proof is supplied. Finite matrix tests and exact rational checks corroborate rather than certify the infinite statement. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Squarefree homogeneous degree-k spherical harmonics only, with d≥2k and an exact number s of positive coordinates. The theorem does not include all harmonics, arbitrary masks, or mixed-degree spaces. The Johnson inclusion algebra and discrete Hamming-shell correlations are established prior tools. Specialist precedence for the assembled continuous result remains possible.
title: Exact all-degree squarefree spherical-harmonic concentration on fixed sign-count regions
